info.title: Grisaia no Rakuen
info.synopsis:
Seguito di Grisaia no Meikyuu
La storia è ambientata nella Mihana Academy, nominalmente una scuola esclusiva ma di fatto un collegio di clausura ove alcuni studenti particolari vengono educati lontano dalle influenze del mondo esterno. La scuola ospita cinque studentesse occupate nella loro ripetitiva routine quotidiana. Un giorno tuttavia, alla Mihana arriva Yuuji Kazami, un nuovo ragazzo in veste di studente…

episodes.title: Il bozzolo della volubilità I
episodes.synopsis: Asako Kusakabe rescues a young Yuuji from terrorists on a certain mission. She has evaded death as a soldier time and time again, and on a whim decides to become Yuuji's guardian. Although she partially forces it, and despite her coworker JB's concerns, the awkward female soldier and young man begin to live under the same roof.

episodes.title: Il bozzolo della volubilità II
episodes.synopsis: Asako's poor health begins to interfere with her work. Yuuji senses her change in condition, and as he covers for her, he starts to think he may have found his life's meaning. Asako tries to respect Yuuji's resolve, but JB, who watches over both of them closely, is apprehensive about Yuuji's attempts to return to that violent world.

episodes.title: Il bozzolo della volubilità III
episodes.synopsis: Yuuji goes to America to follow the same path as Asako, and through his rigorous military life meets and forms a deep bond with war buddies who go through the same joys and sorrows.

episodes.title: Il bozzolo della volubilità IV
episodes.synopsis: Yuuji moves forward on his path as a soldier to protect "an important woman": Asako. However, she leaves his side without waiting until he's reached maturity. Yuuji is yet again tormented by a sense of helplessness, but is saved by Asako's parting words and begins to be able to walk on his own two feet once more.

episodes.title: I semi del Blanc Aile I
episodes.synopsis: After Yuuji suddenly disappears, the girls at Mihama Academy notice him on the TV screen. What's more, it's being reported nationwide that he's a suspect in a terrorist plot which will likely turn into an international incident.

episodes.title: I semi del Blanc Aile II
episodes.synopsis: After Yumiko gets in touch with the informant "Jimmy," she and the other girls at Mihama Academy learn that the current situation is even worse than they thought. Although they have lost Yuuji and have been driven from the academy, they secure a new base of operations and plan a rescue mission for him.

episodes.title: I semi del Blanc Aile III
episodes.synopsis: A formless supporter, "Thanatos," suddenly supports Amane and the others. "Her" objective is also to liberate and rescue Yuuji Kazami. Thanatos and the Mihama girls' interests align and begin preparing to execute their mission. The girls are perplexed by Thanatos's seemingly cryptic instructions that unfold via cell phone, but they bring the girls better results than they ever expected in bringing their goal to fruition.

episodes.title: I semi del Blanc Aile V

Oslo quietly awaits the moment Yuuji Kazami, the final key he needs to fulfill his ambitions, appears before him once more.

related.title: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger The Animation
related.plot: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger è ambientato dopo gli avvenimenti delle serie precedenti e segue le vicende di un nuovo gruppo di eroine: studentesse della Mihama Academy assoldate dall'organizzazione anti-terrorismo "CIRS".

Gli studenti della scuola Mihama dovranno partecipare all'annuale gita fuori porta per addestrarsi in condizioni di reale missione nelle foreste delle Filippine, ma qui riceveranno una richiesta di aiuto da parte della accademia St. Aile: una loro studentessa ha disertato e loro dovranno trovarla e portarla indietro, viva o morta. Cosa avrà portato questa studentessa a non far ritorno alla St. Aile?
